# Queen Cats & Dogs Texture Reference

The two source textures and the reference geometry in this directory come from the CC0-licensed
**Queen Cats & Dogs** project by Ronald Cabrera:

- MC Encyclopedia entry: https://www.mcmod.cn/class/7885.html
- Upstream source: https://github.com/RonaldCabrera/Queen-Cats-Dogs
- Upstream license statement: `README.md` identifies the project as CC0.

The Codex NPC uses the upstream `humanoid_cat_white.png` file unchanged.
`CodexCatgirlModel` is a vanilla-renderer port of the reference geometry so held
items and NPC movement animations continue to work without adding GeckoLib as a
runtime dependency. No colors or outfit pixels are altered.
